issue.title: Deduction guide for `std::thread::name_hint` from `std::basic_string` should ignore the allocator type

discussion.p: Currently, there is a deduction guide for `std::thread::name_hint` that only accepts std::basic_string<T>. Given the corresponding constructor (see ) actually takes std::basic_string_view<T>, presumably it's more reasonable to make the deduction guide accept `basic_string` specializations with different allocator types (e.g. `std::pmr::string`).
